title: Dhumraksha along with army attacks the monkeys
introduction: Dhumraksha along with army attacks the monkeys. A tumultuous battle ensued between the demons and the monkeys. The battle reached frightful proportions in that both the monkeys and demons were killed in large numbers. When Dhumraksha pounced on Hanuman, the latter shattered Dhumraksha's chariot to pieces. Lifting his mace, Dhumraksha fights with Hanuman, who in turn hits him on his head and kills him.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्विपञ्चशः सर्गः
Thus completes 52nd Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षम् प्रेक्ष्य निर्यान्तम् राक्षसम् भीम निस्वनम् |
विनेदुर् वानराह् सर्वे प्रहृष्टा युद्ध कान्क्षिणः
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣam prekṣya niryāntam rākṣasam bhīma nisvanam |
vinedur vānarāh sarve prahṛṣṭā yuddha kānkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Beholding the demon, Dhumraksha of terrible prowess coming forth, all the monkeys waiting for the war, roared with joy.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् तु तुमुलम् युद्धम् सम्जज्ने हरि रक्षसाम् |
अन्योन्यम् पादपैर् घोरैर् निघ्नतम् शूल मुद्गरैः
verses.iast:
teṣām tu tumulam yuddham samjajne hari rakṣasām |
anyonyam pādapair ghorair nighnatam śūla mudgaraiḥ
verses.translation: A highly tumultuous battle was seen between those monkeys and demons, who were slaying each other, with terrible trees, lances and maces.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसैर् वानरा घोरा विनिकृत्ताह् समन्ततः |
वानरै राक्षसाश् च अपि द्रुमैर् भूमौ समी कृताः
verses.iast:
rākṣasair vānarā ghorā vinikṛttāh samantataḥ |
vānarai rākṣasāś ca api drumair bhūmau samī kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The terrible monkeys were moved down on all sides by the demons. The demon too were levelled down to the earth with trees by the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: were levelled down to the earth

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसाश् च अपि सम्क्रुद्धा वानरान् निशितैह् शरैः |
विव्यधुर् घोर सम्काशैह् कन्क पत्रैर् अजिह्मगैः
verses.iast:
rākṣasāś ca api samkruddhā vānarān niśitaih śaraiḥ |
vivyadhur ghora samkāśaih kanka patrair ajihmagaiḥ
verses.translation: Enraged with anger, the demons, on their part, paralyzed the monkeys with sharp and frightful arrows, going as straight as wings of eagle.

verses.devanagari:
ते गदाभिसः च भीमाभिह् पट्टसैह् कूट मुद्गरैः |
घोरैसः च परिघैसः चित्रैस् त्रिशूलैसः च अपि संशितैः
विदार्यमाणा रक्षोभिर् वानरास् ते महा बलाः |
अमर्षाज् जनित उद्धर्षासः चक्रुः कर्माण्य् अभीतवत्
verses.iast:
te gadābhisḥ ca bhīmābhih paṭṭasaih kūṭa mudgaraiḥ |
ghoraisḥ ca parighaisḥ citrais triśūlaisḥ ca api saṃśitaiḥ
vidāryamāṇā rakṣobhir vānarās te mahā balāḥ |
amarṣāj janita uddharṣāsḥ cakruḥ karmāṇy abhītavat
verses.translation: While being torn asunder by the demons with terrible maces, spears, hammers, frightful iron bars and variegated tridents, the mighty monkeys fearlessly accomplished their tasks with an excitement born of anger.

glosses.meaning: with an excitement born of anger.

verses.devanagari:
शर निर्भिन्न गात्रास् ते शूल निर्भिन्न देहिनः |
जगृहुस् ते द्रुमांस् तत्र शिलाश् च हरि यूथपाः
verses.iast:
śara nirbhinna gātrās te śūla nirbhinna dehinaḥ |
jagṛhus te drumāṃs tatra śilāś ca hari yūthapāḥ
verses.translation: While their bodies were split up by the tridents and their limbs broken by arrows, those leaders of monkeys took up trees and rocks there to fight.

glosses.meaning: while their bodies were split up by the tridents
and their limbs broken by arrows

verses.devanagari:
ते भीम वेगा हरयो नर्दमानास् ततस् ततः |
ममन्थू राक्षसान् भीमान् नामानि च बभाषिरे
verses.iast:
te bhīma vegā harayo nardamānās tatas tataḥ |
mamanthū rākṣasān bhīmān nāmāni ca babhāṣire
verses.translation: Those terribly swift monkeys, roaring aloud harassed the valiant demons at all places, by calling out their names.

verses.devanagari:
तद् बभूव अद्भुतम् घोरम् युद्धम् वानर रक्षसाम् |
शिलाभिर् विविधाभिश् च बहु शाखैश् च पादपैः
verses.iast:
tad babhūva adbhutam ghoram yuddham vānara rakṣasām |
śilābhir vividhābhiś ca bahu śākhaiś ca pādapaiḥ
verses.translation: That awful battle with all kinds of rocks and trees furnished with many branches between monkeys and demons appeared wonderful.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसा मथिताह् केचिद् वानरैर् जित काशिभिः |
ववर्षू रुधिरम् केचिन् मुखै रुधिर भोजनाः
verses.iast:
rākṣasā mathitāh kecid vānarair jita kāśibhiḥ |
vavarṣū rudhiram kecin mukhai rudhira bhojanāḥ
verses.translation: Some demons were crushed by monkeys, who conquered fear and some blood-sucking demons vomited blood from their mouths.

verses.devanagari:
पार्श्वेषु दारिताह् केचित् केचिद् राशी कृता द्रुमैः |
शिलाभिसः चूर्णिताः केचित् केचिद् दन्तैर् विदारिताः
verses.iast:
pārśveṣu dāritāh kecit kecid rāśī kṛtā drumaiḥ |
śilābhisḥ cūrṇitāḥ kecit kecid dantair vidāritāḥ
verses.translation: Some demons were slashed open at their sides. Some were formed into a heap by the trees. Some others were crushed by stones and yet others torn to pieces by the monkeys teeth.

verses.devanagari:
ध्वजैर् विमथितैर् भग्नैः खरैश् च विनिपातितैः |
रथैर् विध्वंसितैसः च अपि पतितै रजनी चरैः
verses.iast:
dhvajair vimathitair bhagnaiḥ kharaiś ca vinipātitaiḥ |
rathair vidhvaṃsitaisḥ ca api patitai rajanī caraiḥ
verses.translation: With their standards crushed and broken, their swords snapped and their chariots overturned, some demons were perturbed.

verses.devanagari:
गजेन्द्रैः पर्वताकारैः पर्वताग्रैर्वनौकसाम् |
मथितैर्वाजिभिः कीर्णम् सारोहैर्वसुधातलम्
verses.iast:
gajendraiḥ parvatākāraiḥ parvatāgrairvanaukasām |
mathitairvājibhiḥ kīrṇam sārohairvasudhātalam
verses.translation: Crushed by the great rocks of monkeys, the earth was scattered with corpses of great elephants resembling hills and horses with their riders.

verses.devanagari:
वानरैर् भीम विक्रान्तैर् आप्लुत्य आप्लुत्य वेगितैः |
राक्षसाः करजैस् तीक्ष्णैर् मुखेषु विनिकर्तिताः
verses.iast:
vānarair bhīma vikrāntair āplutya āplutya vegitaiḥ |
rākṣasāḥ karajais tīkṣṇair mukheṣu vinikartitāḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys of terrific prowess rushed upon the demons, flinging themselves upon them with great bounds horizontically and vertically and scratching their faces with their sharp nails.

verses.devanagari:
विवर्ण वदना भूयो विप्रकीर्ण शिरो रुहाः |
मूढाः शोणित गन्धेन निपेतुर् धरणी तले
verses.iast:
vivarṇa vadanā bhūyo viprakīrṇa śiro ruhāḥ |
mūḍhāḥ śoṇita gandhena nipetur dharaṇī tale
verses.translation: With their faces dejected very much, their hair torn out and maddened by the smell of blood, those demons fell on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
नये तु परम क्रुद्धा राक्षसा भीम विक्रमाः |
तलैर् एव अभिधावन्ति वज्र स्पर्श समैर् हरीन्
verses.iast:
naye tu parama kruddhā rākṣasā bhīma vikramāḥ |
talair eva abhidhāvanti vajra sparśa samair harīn
verses.translation: Some other demons of exceeding valour, who were enraged, very much, ran up towards the monkeys to attack them with their palms having a diamond-like blow.

verses.devanagari:
वनरैर् आपतन्तस् ते वेगिता वेगवत्तरैः |
मुष्टिभिसः चरणैर् दन्तैः पादपैसः चाप पोथिताः
verses.iast:
vanarair āpatantas te vegitā vegavattaraiḥ |
muṣṭibhisḥ caraṇair dantaiḥ pādapaisḥ cāpa pothitāḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys, receiving that sharp shock, with even a greater ferocity, crushed the demons with blows of their fists, feet teeth and trees.

verses.devanagari:
सन्यम् तु विद्रुतम् दृष्ट्वा धूम्र अक्षो राक्षस ऋषभः |
रोषेण कदनम् चक्रे वानराणाम् युयुत्सताम्
verses.iast:
sanyam tu vidrutam dṛṣṭvā dhūmra akṣo rākṣasa ṛṣabhaḥ |
roṣeṇa kadanam cakre vānarāṇām yuyutsatām
verses.translation: Seeing his army routed, Dhumraksha that lion among the demons, in his anger began to create a blood-shed of the monkeys wishing to fight.

verses.devanagari:
प्रासैः प्रमथिताः केचिद् वानराः शोणित स्रवाः |
मुद्गरैर् आहताः केचित् पतिता धरणी तले
verses.iast:
prāsaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecid vānarāḥ śoṇita sravāḥ |
mudgarair āhatāḥ kecit patitā dharaṇī tale
verses.translation: Some monkeys pierced with spears lost rivers of blood while others struck down by blows of axe, fell to the earth's surface.

verses.devanagari:
परिघैर् मथितह् केचिद् भिण्डि पालैर् विदारिताः |
पट्टसैर् आहताह् केचिद् विह्वलन्तो गत असवः
verses.iast:
parighair mathitah kecid bhiṇḍi pālair vidāritāḥ |
paṭṭasair āhatāh kecid vihvalanto gata asavaḥ
verses.translation: Some were crushed by iron bars, others torn by harpoons, some others pierced by javelins, all exhausted and lost their lives.

verses.devanagari:
केचिद् विनिहता भूमौ रुधिर आर्द्रा वन ओकसः |
केचिद् विद्राविता नष्टाह् सम्क्रुद्धै राक्षसैर् युधि
verses.iast:
kecid vinihatā bhūmau rudhira ārdrā vana okasaḥ |
kecid vidrāvitā naṣṭāh samkruddhai rākṣasair yudhi
verses.translation: Slain in battle by infuriated demons, some monkeys, drenched with blood, fell on the ground and some others disappeared, having been driven away.

verses.devanagari:
विभिन्न हृदयाः केचिद् एक पार्श्वेन शायिताः |
विदारित अस्त्र शूलै च केचिद् आन्त्रैर् विनिस्रुताः
verses.iast:
vibhinna hṛdayāḥ kecid eka pārśvena śāyitāḥ |
vidārita astra śūlai ca kecid āntrair vinisrutāḥ
verses.translation: With pierced hearts, some monkeys were made to lie down on one side. Some were torn asunder by tridents that even their intestines came out.

verses.devanagari:
तत् सुभीमम् महद् युद्धम् हरि राकस सम्कुलम् |
प्रबभौ शस्त्र बहुलम् शिला पादप सम्कुलम्
verses.iast:
tat subhīmam mahad yuddham hari rākasa samkulam |
prababhau śastra bahulam śilā pādapa samkulam
verses.translation: That mighty battle assumed most awful proportions in that monkeys and demons were crammed with rocks, trees and multitude of weapons.

verses.devanagari:
धनुर् ज्या तन्त्रि मधुरम् हिक्का ताल समन्वितम् |
मन्द्र स्तनित सम्गीतम् युद्ध गान्धर्वम् आबभौ
verses.iast:
dhanur jyā tantri madhuram hikkā tāla samanvitam |
mandra stanita samgītam yuddha gāndharvam ābabhau
verses.translation: With the bow-strings as the tuneful lute, the neighing of horses as a measure rhythm and the trumpeting of elephants as the vocal music, the whole battle resembled a symphony.

glosses.meaning: combat in the form of a symphony ababhau = diffused
with neighing of the horses as rhythms
and vocal music in the form of trumpeting of elephants.

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षस् तु धनुष् पाणिर् वानरान् रण मूर्धनि |
हसन् विद्रावयाम् आस दिशस् तान् शर वृष्टिभिः
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣas tu dhanuṣ pāṇir vānarān raṇa mūrdhani |
hasan vidrāvayām āsa diśas tān śara vṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Dhumraksha on his part, wielding a bow in his hand and laughing at the battle-front, made those monkeys to run away to all the quarters by a shower of his arrows.

glosses.meaning: wielding a bow in his hand
made those monkeys to run away
by a shower of his arrows.

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षेण अर्दितम् सैन्यम् व्यथितम् दृश्य मारुतिः |
अभ्यवर्तत सम्क्रुद्धह् प्रगृह्य विपुलाम् शिलाम्
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣeṇa arditam sainyam vyathitam dṛśya mārutiḥ |
abhyavartata samkruddhah pragṛhya vipulām śilām
verses.translation: Seeing the army perturbed due to tormented by Dhumraksha, Hanuman was enraged and turned towards him, taking a gigantic rock in his hands.

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधाद् द्विगुण ताम्र अक्षह् पितृ तुल्य पराक्रमः |
शिलाम् ताम् पातयाम् आस धूम्र अक्षस्य रथम् प्रति
verses.iast:
krodhād dviguṇa tāmra akṣah pitṛ tulya parākramaḥ |
śilām tām pātayām āsa dhūmra akṣasya ratham prati
verses.translation: Hanuman, who was equal in strength to his father, with his eyes inflamed with anger, flung the rock on the chariot of Dhumraksha.

verses.devanagari:
आपतन्तीम् शिलाम् दृष्ट्वा गदाम् उद्यम्य सम्भ्रमात् |
रथाद् आप्लुत्य वेगेन वसुधायाम् व्यतिष्ठत
verses.iast:
āpatantīm śilām dṛṣṭvā gadām udyamya sambhramāt |
rathād āplutya vegena vasudhāyām vyatiṣṭhata
verses.translation: Beholding the befalling rock, Dhumraksha lifting his mace hurriedly, jumped down speedily from the chariot and stood there on the earth.

verses.devanagari:
सा प्रमथ्य रथम् तस्य निपपात शिला भुवि |
सचक्र कूबरम् साश्वम् सध्वजम् सशर आसनम्
verses.iast:
sā pramathya ratham tasya nipapāta śilā bhuvi |
sacakra kūbaram sāśvam sadhvajam saśara āsanam
verses.translation: Shattering his chariot with its wheels, its pole, its crest along with banner and bows, that rock rolled down to the ground.

verses.devanagari:
स भन्क्त्वा तु रथम् तस्य हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
रक्षसाम् कदनम् चक्रे सस्कन्ध विटपैर् द्रुमैः
verses.iast:
sa bhanktvā tu ratham tasya hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ |
rakṣasām kadanam cakre saskandha viṭapair drumaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, Hanuman the son of Maruta (the wind-god), after breaking the chariot, destroyed the demons with trunks of trees furnished with their branches.

verses.devanagari:
विभिन्न शिरसो भूत्वा राक्षसाह् शोणित उक्षिताः |
द्रुमैः प्रमथितासः च अन्ये निपेतुर् धरणी तले
verses.iast:
vibhinna śiraso bhūtvā rākṣasāh śoṇita ukṣitāḥ |
drumaiḥ pramathitāsḥ ca anye nipetur dharaṇī tale
verses.translation: With their heads crushed, the demons were drenched with blood. Some others were crunched by the trees and fell down to the earth.

verses.devanagari:
विद्राव्य राक्षसम् सैन्यम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
गिरेः शिखरम् आदाय धूम्र अक्षम् अभिदुद्रुवे
verses.iast:
vidrāvya rākṣasam sainyam hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ |
gireḥ śikharam ādāya dhūmra akṣam abhidudruve
verses.translation: Having driven away the army of demons, Hanuma born of Maruta, breaking off the peak of a mountain, ran towards Dhumraksha.

verses.devanagari:
तम् आपतन्तम् धूम्र अक्षो गदाम् उद्यम्य वीर्यवान् |
विनर्दमानः सहसा हनूमन्तम् अभिद्रवत्
verses.iast:
tam āpatantam dhūmra akṣo gadām udyamya vīryavān |
vinardamānaḥ sahasā hanūmantam abhidravat
verses.translation: The valiant Dhumraksha lifted his mace and making a roaring sound, ran towards that Hanuman who was rushing on him suddenly.

verses.devanagari:
ततः क्रुद्धस् तु वेगेन गदाम् ताम् बहु कण्टकाम् |
पातयाम् आस धूम्र अक्षो मस्तके तु हनूमतः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kruddhas tu vegena gadām tām bahu kaṇṭakām |
pātayām āsa dhūmra akṣo mastake tu hanūmataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, Dhumraksha with an outrage, brought down that mace studded with countless spikes on the head of that Hanuma.

verses.devanagari:
ताडितह् स तया तत्र गदया भीम रूपया |
स कपिर् मारुत बलस् तम् प्रहारम् अचिन्तयन्
धूम्र अक्षस्य शिरो मध्ये गिरि शृन्गम् अपातयत् |
verses.iast:
tāḍitah sa tayā tatra gadayā bhīma rūpayā |
sa kapir māruta balas tam prahāram acintayan
dhūmra akṣasya śiro madhye giri śṛngam apātayat |
verses.translation: That Hanuman, who was endowed with an energy similar to the wind, was in no way disturbed by that blow but struck Dhumraksha on the middle of his skull with his rocky peak.

glosses.meaning: with an energy similar to the wind
on the middle of the skull

verses.devanagari:
स विह्वलित सर्व अन्गो गिरि शृन्गेण ताडितः
पपात सहसा भूमौ विकीर्ण;इव पर्वतः |
verses.iast:
sa vihvalita sarva ango giri śṛngeṇa tāḍitaḥ
papāta sahasā bhūmau vikīrṇa;iva parvataḥ |
verses.translation: That Dhumraksha, struck by the rocky peak, which shattered all his limbs, soon fell down on the ground like a mountain crumbling.

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षम् निहतम् दृष्ट्वा हत शेषा निशा चराः
त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर् लन्काम् वध्यमानाः प्लवम् गमैः |
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣam nihatam dṛṣṭvā hata śeṣā niśā carāḥ
trastāḥ praviviśur lankām vadhyamānāḥ plavam gamaiḥ |
verses.translation: Seeing Dhumraksha having been killed, the demons left surviving were frightened of being killled by the monkeys and re entered Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
स तु पवन सुतो निहत्य शत्रुम् |
क्षतज वहाह् सरितश् च सम्विकीर्य |
रिपु वध जनित श्रमो महात्मा |
मुदम् अगमत् कपिभिश् च पूज्यमानः
verses.iast:
sa tu pavana suto nihatya śatrum |
kṣataja vahāh saritaś ca samvikīrya |
ripu vadha janita śramo mahātmā |
mudam agamat kapibhiś ca pūjyamānaḥ
verses.translation: That illustrious Hanuman the son of Pavana having destroyed his enemies, causing rivers of blood to flow, weary of slaughter of the enemies, with delight, received the cordial felicitations by the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: shramaH = weary of slaughter of enemies
